article.title: Palestinian youth may soon get to vote for the first time. Few believe it actually matters.
article.author: Qassam Muaddi
article.content: With 64 percent of Palestinians under 30 and elections announced for November, a generation that has never voted is being asked to trust a political system that has failed them — before, during, and after the genocide in Gaza.
